versions.changelog:
- Added support for bolding inside list items as an explicit, on-demand exception (e.g. Benefits lists), instead of never bolding lists.
- Updated constraints and procedure: routine list-item bolding is discouraged, but allowed decisively when requested, with at most one bold concept per item.
- Clarified that a bolded list may bring total highlights up to ~15, but all other highlights should remain spare.
- Improved error handling for requests to bold entire lists or sections.
- Removed redundant skill-card.md file for simplicity.

- Revamped highlighting to be much sparser: aim for just 5–10 bolded concepts per article instead of one or two per paragraph.
- Updated constraints: never bold list items, allow at most one highlight per paragraph, and most paragraphs should have none.
- Refined procedure and verification steps to focus on picking truly key arc moments—highlights should feel rare and deliberate.
- Added explicit error handling for user instruction to bold only one thing, and clarified not to bold in non-article files.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md.

Initial release of bold-highlights skill.

- Adds concise bold highlights to core concepts in each paragraph of an article.
- Ensures only 1–2 key words or short phrases per paragraph are bolded, following clear constraints.
- Avoids repeats in adjacent paragraphs and skips obvious context and proper nouns.
- Designed to make articles in ai-thoughts/docs/ more scannable while maintaining readability.
- Includes error handling for inappropriate contexts and user opt-outs.
